name: Config Revision
description: Allows to create revision for the config entities.
project_description:
This module allows creating revision for config entities.

 The module adds a lightweight revisionable entity which is bundleable and non-translatable. The admin settings page can be used to make any config entity revisionable. A new revision is saved every time a config entity is saved. The config revision entity ignores the changes made to the config entities during config import. 

 This module depends on the following core patch [#2350939-202] for revision UI to work properly.
